name: superskillret
description: Embedding-based skill retrieval for Claude Code. On every user prompt, picks the top-K relevant skills from a 16,783-skill pool and injects them as context. v0.2.8: /list and /remove move to dedicated cli scripts (avoids inline-heredoc env-var fragility that left them stuck on 'no module named daemon_client'); retrieve.py now shows daemon health on every emit ('daemon: ready (N skills, Xs)' or 'daemon: cold start') so users see whether retrieval actually fired. v0.2.7 install lock cleanup + log tail; v0.2.6 daemon_client.py; v0.2.5 dedup OFF + used self-report; v0.2.0–0.2.4 custom skill registration + UX fixes.
